issues.on_page: Transfers Between Funds Out 9,159.06; From: Lamar To: Chase County Treasurer; remaining fund balance 9,154.99 remitted 1/14/2025 plus interest 4.07 on 4/15/2025 (village unincorporated 1/1/2025)
issues.issue: One-sided transfer: the village's whole remaining balance went to another government (Chase County) when it dissolved, not to another village fund. The extraction has no decision_needed[] entry. A person should decide whether this is a transfer or a payment to another entity (disbursement).
Short final period (6.5 months, village dissolved). The year end is taken from the printed period, which is defensible, but the period isn't a full fiscal year.
Local Receipts (88% of receipts) not itemized on the waiver form; 'other' with review is defensible, but the fund type has >10% in other
